http.scope: Production HTTP, metadata and reviewed PNG/SVG comparison. No analytics or cluster execution.

browser.scope: 102 cases on 34 fetched production viewers; motion/reduced-motion/visibility/theme/guided controls and 34 SVG exports; web fonts blocked intentionally with local Noto fallback; no server/sitebuild
